Add to Google Calendar. Carnegie Mellon University group. Opens an ICS file in a new tab.
buttons.onclick:
alert('If clicking on this link does not work, please try the alternative method below: 
1) Click on the link called Link (on the right) and copy the link as instructed
2) Go to Google Calendar and look for Other Calendars (on the left)
3) Click on the little arrow on the right and select Add as URL
4) Paste the link you had copied and click on Add Calendar')
